title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Semester Limit on Payment Plans
content:
**Clause.** A Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program payment plan is limited by the semester. The billing months are counted from the enrollment's most recently posted billing month through the last billing month of its semester, both included. That last month is December (billing month 2026-12) for a fall month and May (billing month 2027-05) for a spring month. The count sets the limit:

| Billing months counted | Most payments allowed |
|---|---|
| at most 2 | 2 |
| more than 2 and at most 4 | 3 |
| more than 4 | no limit |

## The count for each billing month

| Most recently posted billing month | Months counted through the semester's last | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| August 2026 | 5 | no limit |
| September 2026 | 4 | 3 |
| October 2026 | 3 | 3 |
| November 2026 | 2 | 2 |
| December 2026 | 1 | 2 |
| January 2027 | 5 | no limit |
| February 2027 | 4 | 3 |
| March 2027 | 3 | 3 |
| April 2027 | 2 | 2 |
| May 2027 | 1 | 2 |

The month read is the billing month of the latest tuition charge on the enrollment's billing history, not the calendar month of the call.
